headlines: Full Stack Developer | C# · .NET · TypeScript · Azure
Available for hire: permanent roles and project contracts
<Wanted To Be A Ninja But Chose Code Instead />
bio: I build practical, scalable web applications end to end: frontend, APIs, databases, cloud and the pipelines in between.

My experience covers enterprise web development with C# and ASP.NET, frontends in Vue.js, Angular and React, Node.js backends, SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases, Azure Function Apps, and deployment through Azure DevOps.

I do my best work on hard problems: improving systems end to end and shipping clean code that does what the business needs. I review code across teams, mentor developers and help unblock technical work.
I'm open to permanent roles and contract work, and I also help small businesses with computer repair, IT advice, websites and custom applications. Call or WhatsApp me.
